sara_sales: Quick sync — Theta Finance POC. Their security team sent a list of enterprise auth questions (SSO/SAML, SCIM group sync, RBAC mapping, domain controls). Need a short checklist + a config snippet they can hand to their IdP, and any pricing notes for Dedicated/private options. ETA: EOW.

alex_se: Confirmed — customer uses Okta primarily, AzureAD as backup. They want SCIM group sync into our RBAC roles and SAML SP-initiated SSO.

jordan_sales_engineer: They also asked about group->role mapping details and whether we support SCIM PATCH and bulk imports.

mike_security: From security POV: we require SAML 2.0, SP-initiated or IdP-initiated OK, signed assertions (RSASSA-PSS or RSA-SHA256), audience restriction set to our Entity ID, and assertion encryption optional. Cert rotation window recommended <=90 days. We also need NameID/email + groups attribute mapping. For SCIM: v2 preferred, must support PATCH and bulk (we handle bulk via paging), and service account with scoped token.

nina_sre: Domain controls: for hosted orgs we verify primary domains via DNS TXT (preferred) or HTTP challenge. For Private/VPC installs we require customer-managed DNS and proof-of-ownership (TXT). If they want automatic provisioning of org-level domains we need a delegated CNAME for verification, but manual TXT is fine for POC.

alex_se: Pricing notes: SSO + SCIM are included in Enterprise tier. Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) adds a monthly commitment — quoting model separately. Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) is a licensed add-on + setup fee. For POC, propose a 30–60 day complimentary Dedicated trial (sales discretion) and then convert to a short-term reserved quote if they like perf.

sara_sales: Can someone assemble a 1-page checklist + a minimal SAML/SCIM snippet they can give their IdP team? Also need a one-line explanation of how RBAC gets populated from SCIM groups.

mike_security: I'll draft the checklist. Quick notes I'll include: data flow (SCIM tokens scoped, no user credentials stored), assertion constraints, allowed algorithms, cert rotation guidance, audit log retention options, and DPA/KMS callouts.

jordan_sales_engineer: Paste for IdP team — they asked for exact endpoints/config: 

```
SAML SP config (to give IdP):
- ACS URL: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs
- Entity ID: https://redwood.ai/saml/sp
- NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
- Attributes: email -> Email, groups -> Groups
- Requested Sign/Encrypt: Sign assertions; encryption optional

SCIM (v2) service info:
- Base URL: https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2
- Auth: Bearer token (service account)
- Required endpoints: /Users, /Groups
- PATCH: supported (SCIM PATCH operations accepted)
```

sara_sales: Nice — that'll help. Mike/Nina, can you drop the final checklist + any compliance callouts (DPA/KMS) in this thread by EOD tomorrow? I'll loop in Theta's IdP contacts once we have the snippet.

mike_security: On it. Also tagging legal for the DPA: @legal (will follow up).

deploybot: POC environment provisioned: theta-poc-197250 (expires in 28 days). 

sara_sales: Great. I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Theta's infra + IdP teams. Thanks all :thumbsup:
